hypotheses.justification: Split into n = 0 and 0 < n; the positive case uses the existing proof. For n = 0, VeroneseZero.lean defines zeroVariable 𝒮, the degree-one copy of 1, which belongs to component 𝒮 0 1 by mem_component_iff. Its lemma of_zero_eq_algebraMap_mul_pow expresses every direct-sum generator as a degree-zero coefficient times a power of zeroVariable. Thus Algebra.subset_adjoin and closure under coefficients, multiplication, powers and addition prove the conclusion by DirectSum.induction_on. This zero-index argument needs neither hgen nor nontriviality and works for the zero ring too.
